description: A conditional with an unknown predicate doesn't report an error in a result
notes: The spec passes an error in a result through only if that result is selected, and an unknown predicate selects neither, which is what hashicorp/hcl does. The spec doesn't say what type a result that failed contributes to the unified type: hashicorp/hcl gives the failed + operation its usual type, number (BinaryOpExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression_ops.go returns an unknown number along with the error), so the conditional gives an unknown number (ConditionalExpr.Value in hclsyntax/expression.go).
